description: A model-generated cyber intrusion, exploiting a poisoned software dependency, cascaded through public health and energy coordination systems across multiple member states. Response was fragmented, attribution slow. The attack did not collapse services, but exposed a paralyzing lag between AI-enabled offense and human-led defense. Public confidence eroded further, with protests intensifying in cities where job losses in professional sectors have become entrenched.

Amid sustained public distrust and low uptake in retraining programs, a cross-national coalition of displaced mid-career professionals organizes visible, coordinated protests targeting AI deployment in public administration and licensing reforms. The movement gains traction in media coverage and forces several regional governments to pause automation initiatives.
